==Hero Usage==
Heroes use this as a basic damage skill, ignoring its conditional bonus.

==Notes==
*There are no Ranger skills which inflict Cracked Armor.
*Great synergy with [[Sundering Weapon]].

==Trivia==
*The [[Monk]] in the [[skill icon]] is wearing [[Monk Woven armor|Woven armor]].
*The skill icon resembles the icon of the Elementalist skill [[Shell Shock]].
*[[gw2:Body Shot|Body Shot]] is also the name of a skill in ''[[Guild Wars 2]]''.
